title: Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) is affected by an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command…
description: Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) is affected by a critical SQL Injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-105779) that allows a low-privileged attacker to bypass security features and gain unauthorized read and limited write access without user interaction. The vulnerability changes the security scope and poses a significant risk to confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
